Name: Noclip Mode
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
[b]Noclip Mode[/b] lets you press a button to walk through anything (even map boundaries). Can also be enabled in cutscenes to fix broken events.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/NoclipMode/docs/animated.gif[/img]
[b][color=#6aa84f]
[b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b][/color][/b]


[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=6][b]How to use[/b][/size]
Press [font=Courier New]F11[/font] to toggle noclip mode. When it's enabled, nothing can stop you.

See [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/NoclipMode/docs/README.md#configure][i]configure[/i] in the readme[/url] to change the key.


[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]

[/list]
